claim: To store a value a GitHub Action needs, a repository admin opens the repository Settings, then Secrets and variables under the Security section, then Actions, the Secrets tab, and New repository secret, and enters a name and the value. A workflow refers to it by name through the secrets context, never by value. A secret cannot be used directly in an if condition; assign it to a job-level environment variable first. GitHub advises masking non-secret sensitive values and avoiding passing secrets on the command line. Secrets over 48 KB are not supported directly.
